scope: Read-only bounded AB coverage and object-binding audit. No new training or collection before evidence review. C restricted to previously reported errors.
independent_unit: Existing root initial layout/seed, not frames, queries, reset branches or adjacent windows. Count each root once per category; positive/negative memberships may overlap.
population: All420new-semantics AB windows; legacy228 AB windows do not carry In/drawer supervision and are excluded from those coverages.

categories.tabletop_closed: Closed valid true; object has upward table-base contact, bottom z0.44±0.005m, not Held.
categories.contained_closed: Closed valid true AND In valid true; positive-defined state, with all_closed_states separately reporting unbiased positive/negative composition.
categories.falling_now: Unheld, no current upward external support force>0.01N/nz>0.5/gap<=3mm, downward vz<-0.02m/s.
categories.fallen_below_table: Unheld, no drawer load-bearing path, whole object top z<0.30m; distinguish from active falling.
categories.protruding_supported: Outside by frozen full-OBB labels but drawer load-bearing path exists.
categories.near_boundary_supported: Drawer-supported and abs minimum side/rim clearance<5mm; descriptive audit, no label threshold change.

implementation_checks: Recompute all AB labels from original physical snapshots, inspect saved target column and object-region mapping, all6entity permutations and alias/order checks on allAB with frozen checkpoints; target goal metadata must not affect shared reader probability.
randomness: Existing runs use onlyseed0; do not claim seed variance or create extra seeds merely to explain one C error. Saved checkpoints may be read solely to explain existing C failures.
decision: Clear label/binding bug can justify original fixed experiment repair. Coverage-only deficiency may justify one preregistered independent AB/C batch. Otherwise stop tuning and report wider choice needed.
preserve: All old source, labels, scores and candidate decisions read-only. No newD, cloud, paid APIs, controller or original gate changes.
